ACT XII OF 2018
ACT XII OF 2018
BALOCHISTAN CIVIL SERVANTS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act to further amend the Balochistan Civil
Servants Act, 1974 (Act IX of 1974)
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
19th June, 2018]
No.
PAB / Legis; V(29) / 2018, dated 19.6.2018.---The Balochistan Civil Servants (Amendment) Bill, 2018 (Bill No.29 of
2018), having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 31st
May, 2018 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on 13th June, 2018 is
hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient further to amend the
Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (Act IX of 1974), for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Balochistan Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
